title: 第二十二章 父母爱情第二十三章 必须给他搅黄了
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
第二十二章父母爱情
长达两个月的假期正式开始，唐斩月这几天除了吃喝跟叶峥聊天，大部分时间都花在研究机甲上。
唐渊见她这么感兴趣，直接给她开通了随意出入集团机甲研发部的权限，甚至还给了资源调动权，顺便安了个实习的名头。
过去几年，庄怀一直觉得BOSS不太喜欢自己女儿，但这几天接连发生的事，已经让小姐在他心里的地位拔高到跟夫人同一层次了。
庄怀连夜回想自己之前有没有得罪过小姐，生怕影响他成为集团两朝元老的职业规划。
就在唐斩月来集团实习的第一天，唐渊收到了一条消息：两个小时后抵达主星，快来接驾！
唐渊立马推了工作，下楼把唐斩月一起带走。
“我才搞了一半！！”唐斩月大声抗议。
唐渊语气荡漾，“你妈妈回来了。”
唐斩月心头一跳，她失联多日的漂亮妈妈回来了？怎么办，十几年没见了，她好紧张！
要不要换身衣服，梳个头再化个妆，见面礼送哪个比较好……
唐渊带她去了一家私人造型工作室，父女俩分别进入不同的造型间，搭衣服做造型，郑重得不得了。
唐斩月天生丽质，不到一个小时就搞好了，换上可爱的小裙子，扎上花苞头，脸上画了粉嫩的淡妆。
化妆师被她可爱得直跺脚，她也想要这么漂亮的女鹅！！
唐斩月本人无知无觉，搞完就去隔壁找她的老父亲，她还天真地以为唐渊会比她先弄完，期间一直在催化妆师。
结果，她还是低估了妈妈在老爸心里的重要程度。
一个大男人做妆造比女孩子时间还长，你说说这像话吗！
刚走到门口，唐斩月就听见一道恶熏熏的甜腻夹子音：“唐总，您看这套衣服怎么样？”
唐斩月情不自禁地抖了抖，应激似的一脚把门踹开。
门内，唐渊正眉头紧皱地照镜子，似乎对这身衣服不太满意。

一旁的女人手里拎着一套西装，满脸倾慕地看着他。
这一幕，多像霸总和他的温柔人妻？如果男主角不是她爸就更完美了。
女人转头看向唐斩月，眉眼间满是被打扰的不悦，“谁让你进来的？”
唐斩月上下打量她，随后嗤了声，看向唐渊，“再不走就要迟到了。”
唐渊看了眼时间，从这里到星际港口要五十分钟，加上预留的十分钟，他只剩下不到十分钟打理自己了。
“你觉得这套怎么样？”
唐斩月认真看了看，竖起大拇指，“非常帅！”
唐渊紧皱的眉头松开，“那就这样吧。”他走到化妆台前，慢条斯理地戴上一应配饰。
女人愣了下，“唐总，这套不试了吗？”
唐渊没理她，戴上东西后就出了门。
唐斩月也没再看她一眼，跟在老爸身后缓步离开。
女人看着空荡荡的门口，表情扭曲地将衣服摔在地上。
就在这时，工作室的老板来了，他面无表情地瞥了眼地上的衣服，淡漠道：“这套西装的价格是38.8万星币，会从你的工资里扣除。”
女人面色变了，赶紧把衣服拎起来，“不小心掉了而已，我会处理干净。”
老板不置可否地哼了声，说出重点：“你被开除了。”
女人一脸被雷劈了的表情，“为什么？”
content_en:
Chapter 22 Parental Love
The two-month vacation has officially begun. In addition to eating, drinking and chatting with Ye Zheng these days, Tang Zhanyue spent most of his time studying mechas.
Seeing that she was so interested, Tang Yuan directly gave her permission to enter and leave the group's mecha research and development department at will. He even gave her the right to mobilize resources and gave her an internship title.
In the past few years, Zhuang Huai has always felt that the boss didn't like his daughter very much, but the events that happened one after another in the past few days have raised the young lady's status in his heart to the same level as his wife.
Zhuang Huai spent the night thinking about whether he had offended the young lady before, for fear of affecting his career plan to become a veteran of the group for two dynasties.
On Tang Zhanyue's first day as an intern at the group, Tang Yuan received a message: He will arrive at the main star in two hours, come and pick him up!
Tang Yuan immediately put off work and went downstairs to take Tang Zhanyue away with him.
"I'm only halfway done!!" Tang Zhanyue protested loudly.
Tang Yuan's tone was rippling, "Your mother is back."
Tang Zhanyue's heart skipped a beat. Her beautiful mother, who had been missing for many days, was back? What should I do? We haven’t seen each other for more than ten years. She is so nervous!
Do you want to change your clothes, comb your hair and put on make-up, which one is better to give as a meeting gift...
Tang Yuan took her to a private styling studio. The father and daughter entered different styling rooms to put on clothes and do styling, which was extremely solemn.
Tang Zhanyue was naturally beautiful, and she finished it in less than an hour. She put on a cute little skirt, tied up her hair, and put on pink makeup on her face.
The makeup artist was so cute that she stamped her feet. She also wanted such a beautiful female goose! !
Tang Zhanyue herself was ignorant and went next door to find her old father after finishing it. She naively thought that Tang Yuan would finish it before her, so she kept urging the makeup artist.
As a result, she still underestimated the importance of her mother in her father's heart.
Is it ridiculous for a grown man to spend more time doing makeup than a girl?
As soon as he walked to the door, Tang Zhanyue heard a sweet and sweet voice: "Mr. Tang, what do you think of this suit?"
Tang Zhanyue couldn't help but tremble, and kicked the door open as if in a hurry.
Inside the door, Tang Yuan was looking in the mirror with a frown on his face, as if he was not satisfied with his clothes.
The woman on the side was holding a suit in her hands and looking at him with admiration.
How much does this scene look like the boss and his gentle wife? It would be perfect if the male protagonist wasn't her father.
The woman turned to look at Tang Zhanyue, her eyebrows full of displeasure at being disturbed, "Who asked you to come in?"
Tang Zhanyue looked her up and down, then sneered and looked at Tang Yuan, "You'll be late if you don't leave."
Tang Yuan looked at the time. It took fifty minutes to get to the interstellar port from here. Including the ten minutes reserved, he only had less than ten minutes left to take care of himself.
"What do you think of this set?"
Tang Zhanyue looked at it carefully and gave a thumbs up, "Very handsome!"
Tang Yuan relaxed his frown, "Then let's do it." He walked to the dressing table and slowly put on some accessories.
The woman was stunned for a moment, "Mr. Tang, don't you want to try this?"
Tang Yuan ignored her, put on his things and went out.
Tang Zhanyue didn't even look at her again, and slowly left behind her father.
The woman looked at the empty door with a twisted expression and threw her clothes to the ground.
Just then, the boss of the studio came. He glanced at the clothes on the ground expressionlessly and said indifferently: "The price of this suit is 388,000 star coins, and it will be deducted from your salary."
The woman's expression changed and she quickly picked up her clothes, "I just accidentally dropped them. I will clean them up."
The boss snorted noncommittally and said the key point: "You're fired."
The woman looked struck by lightning, "Why?"
